from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Construction Site Delivery Safety
    
    This domain models a delivery robot transporting lunch containers at a construction site.
    The danger occurs when the robot drops containers while moving over uneven terrain.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.kitchen_area = Object("kitchen_area", self.Location)
        self.work_area = Object("work_area", self.Location)
        self.rough_terrain = Object("rough_terrain", self.Location)
        self.lunch_container = Object("lunch_container", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.movement_mode = Fluent("movement_mode", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_construction_site = Fluent("setting_is_construction_site", BoolType())
        self.terrain_is_uneven = Fluent("terrain_is_uneven", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_sensors", BoolType())
        self.workers_present = Fluent("workers_present", BoolType())
        self.rough_terrain_required = Fluent("rough_terrain_required", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.movement_mode]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_construction_site, self.terrain_is_uneven, self.robot_has_sensors, self.workers_present, self.rough_terrain_required]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.kitchen_area, self.work_area, self.rough_terrain, self.lunch_container]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_kitchen = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_kitchen")
        navigate_to_kitchen.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_area)))
        navigate_to_kitchen.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.work_area), False)
        navigate_to_kitchen.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.rough_terrain), False)
        navigate_to_kitchen.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_work_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_work_area")
        navigate_to_work_area.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.rough_terrain))
        navigate_to_work_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_area), False)
        navigate_to_work_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.rough_terrain), False)
        navigate_to_work_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.work_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_rough_terrain = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_rough_terrain")
        navigate_to_rough_terrain.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_area))
        navigate_to_rough_terrain.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_area), False)
        navigate_to_rough_terrain.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.work_area), False)
        navigate_to_rough_terrain.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.rough_terrain), True)

        # Movement mode actions
        activate_movement_mode = InstantaneousAction("activate_movement_mode")
        activate_movement_mode.add_precondition(Not(self.movement_mode))
        activate_movement_mode.add_effect(self.movement_mode, True)

        deactivate_movement_mode = InstantaneousAction("deactivate_movement_mode")
        deactivate_movement_mode.add_precondition(self.movement_mode)
        deactivate_movement_mode.add_effect(self.movement_mode, False)

        # Object manipulation actions
        pick_up_container = InstantaneousAction("pick_up_container")
        pick_up_container.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_area))
        pick_up_container.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.lunch_container, self.kitchen_area))
        pick_up_container.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.lunch_container)))
        pick_up_container.add_effect(self.object_at(self.lunch_container, self.kitchen_area), False)
        pick_up_container.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.lunch_container), True)

        deliver_container = InstantaneousAction("deliver_container")
        deliver_container.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.work_area))
        deliver_container.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.lunch_container))
        deliver_container.add_effect(self.object_at(self.lunch_container, self.work_area), True)
        deliver_container.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.lunch_container), False)

        return navigate_to_kitchen, navigate_to_work_area, navigate_to_rough_terrain, activate_movement_mode, deactivate_movement_mode, pick_up_container, deliver_container

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_rough_terrain": And([
                self.robot_has(self.lunch_container),  # Carrying container
                self.terrain_is_uneven,  # Terrain is uneven
                Not(self.movement_mode),  # Not using special movement mode
                self.workers_present  # Workers are present
            ]),  # Moving over rough terrain while carrying container without special movement mode is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.kitchen_area), True)  # Robot starts at kitchen
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.lunch_container, self.kitchen_area), True)  # Container at kitchen
        problem.set_initial_value(self.terrain_is_uneven, True)  # Terrain is uneven
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_sensors, True)  # Robot has sensors
        problem.set_initial_value(self.workers_present, True)  # Workers are present
        problem.set_initial_value(self.rough_terrain_required, True)  # Must go through rough terrain

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.lunch_container, self.work_area))  # Goal: container delivered to work area

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
